youtube.intro: One Monday morning, a number appears above every head you see: that person's bank balance, live, to the cent. Green if they have money, red if they owe it. Nobody else can see them. At first it's the best game in the world. Then you look at your mum.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Would you have signed the paper for your mum? 👇

And why can Ellie see the numbers, when nobody else can? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The real parts check out: about 4 in 10 US adults can't cover a surprise $400 bill with cash, Americans owe over $1 trillion on credit cards, only about 1 in 100 adults on Earth is a millionaire, and over $10 billion was reported lost to fraud in a single year. Sources are in the description.
